name: queeny-store-pos
description: Queeny Store POS - offline-first sari-sari store point of sale with Utang, cashier, and online sync.

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('www',{recursive:true});['index.html','manifest.json','sw.js','icon.png','icon-192.png'].forEach(f=>{if(fs.existsSync(f))fs.copyFileSync(f,'www/'+f)});if(!fs.existsSync('www/index.html'))throw new Error('index.html is missing');console.log('www ready');"
scripts.apk: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
